title: skills: objectstack-ui never teaches navigation: { openNewTab: true }, the replacement for a list's retired new_window
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kDGa1ViantgrfH797

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · from the contract review of PR #36302 (#35870 skills half): nit N2 in record 7074880702 and again in delta PASS 7075275019 (N4 there adds weight). The seat asked for it to be filed as p3 on pm:queue and not dispatched.

## What happens
After #35854, `navigation.mode` on an object's list no longer picks how a record opens. The spec's `@deprecated` JSDoc on `mode` (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`) and the ADR-0087 D3 entry `navigation-mode-record-open-deprecated` both give `navigation: { openNewTab: true }` as the replacement for a list that declared `new_window`. PR #36302's step 5 of `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md` now tells authors to omit `drawer`, `page` and `new_window`. No file in the bundle teaches `openNewTab`, so an author who wants records to open in a new tab gets no route.

## Done when
`skills/objectstack-ui` teaches, in one short clause where step 5 names `new_window` (or the `navigation.md` Surface bullet), that a list that wants records in a new tab writes `navigation: { openNewTab: true }`. Each sentence must match the spec describe and the migration entry. The token ratchet must hold: `rules/record-page.md` has about 3 tokens of headroom, so pay the bytes in the same file. No eval change unless a case asks about new tabs.

reach: AI authors using the objectstack-ui skill; read from the skill files and the spec.
Business reason: an author asking for "open in a new tab" today gets no taught key and may re-declare the retired `new_window`.
Reader: skills (objectstack-ui).
Dedupe: `openNewTab skills` gives only #35870 (the parent, whose skills half is PR #36302).
Grade: p3.
